title: PrintWindow flag=0 GDI path for legacy Win32 apps (nfrunlite/nkrunlite/Kiwoom HTS)
desc: PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT (flag=2) routes through DWM GPU compositing and returns blank for GDI apps. TryPrintWindowOnly now tries: flag=2 (DirectX) -> flag=0 (GDI WM_PRINT) -> BitBlt GetWindowDC. nfrunlite/nkrunlite/Kiwoom HTS captured correctly with flag=0.
steps: BitBlt GetWindowDC is last resort for GPU-composited windows where both PrintWindow flags fail
PrintWindow flag=0: pure GDI WM_PRINT message path, works on legacy Win32 apps (nfrunlite/nkrunlite/Kiwoom HTS)
PrintWindow flag=2 (PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT): DWM GPU compositing path, DirectX/WPF only -- blank on GDI apps
TryPrintWindowOnly order: flag=2 first -> blank -> flag=0 -> blank -> BitBlt GetWindowDC
ScreenCapture.FastPath.cs: commit 9562df7b added flag=0 middle tier between flag=2 and BitBlt
Do NOT use flag=2 exclusively -- blank result on GDI apps is expected, fall through to flag=0
author: claude
